name: Fuurin no Uta
source:
Main character is a university student who sees the same dream every day. The dream depicts his breaking up with his lover two years ago. Guilt and regret feelings make him ride a bike and go on a trip somewhere his memories can't reach him. What will he encounter in this journey?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名每天做着同一个梦的大学生。梦中描绘的是两年前他和恋人分手的场景。愧疚和遗憾驱使他骑上摩托车，前往记忆无法触及的地方旅行。在这段旅途中他会遇到什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
